responsibility: Declares `Go_dump`, the small registry object used to define and query named Go frontend debug dumps controlled by `-fgo-dump-XXX` options. This header provides the common enable-by-name interface and per-dump state that other frontend files instantiate to gate optional debug output.
same_name_distinction: Declares the lightweight `Go_dump` descriptor class used by other frontend files to register and query dump flags. Unlike go-dump.cc, it exposes the per-dump interface but does not maintain the global dump list or implement enablement.
